blocks.text: Pickleball with a view? Cebu now has a new place to try it. bai Hotel Cebu officially opened the bai Pickle Club last September 19, 2026, featuring three indoor, air-conditioned pickleball courts on the hotel’s seventh floor. Designed for casual games, friendly matches, and organized tournaments, the bai Pickle Club offers a space for players to enjoy the sport regardless of skill level or occasion.
